skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike fractional parts and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with the same denominator by subtracting numerators while keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Handle mixed and whole numbers
skills.definition: Separate mixed or whole numbers into whole and fractional parts, subtract whole-number parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more wholes into fractional form when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero fractional part to the appropriate integer or zero form.
